summary: Results-driven Medical and Health Services Manager with over 10 years of progressive experience overseeing clinical and administrative operations in growing mid-market healthcare organizations. Skilled in fiscal management, staff supervision, regulatory compliance, and implementing technology solutions to improve patient care and operational efficiency.

experience.title: Director of Health Services Management
bullets: Direct, supervise, and evaluate work activities of 85+ medical, nursing, technical, clerical, and service personnel across three facilities, achieving a 92% employee satisfaction rate.
Developed and maintained a computerized record management system to store and process personnel and patient data, reducing reporting time by 40% and improving data accuracy.

Plan, implement, and administer programs and services including personnel administration, training, and coordination of medical, nursing, and physical plant staff, resulting in a 25% increase in operational efficiency.

Conduct and administer fiscal operations including accounting, budget planning, authorizing expenditures, establishing rates for services, and coordinating financial reporting for a $12M annual budget.

Maintain awareness of advances in medicine, diagnostic equipment, data processing technology, government regulations, and health insurance changes, implementing 5 new compliance protocols within 18 months.

Monitor use of diagnostic services, inpatient beds, facilities, and staff to ensure effective resource use and assess need for additional staff, equipment, and services, reducing patient wait times by 30%.

experience.title: Health Services Manager
bullets: Directed recruitment, hiring, and training of 60+ clinical and administrative staff, reducing turnover by 22% through improved onboarding and mentorship programs.
Established work schedules and assignments for staff according to workload, space, and equipment availability, optimizing coverage and reducing overtime costs by 18%.
Managed fiscal operations including accounting, budget planning, and authorizing expenditures for a $7M department budget while coordinating monthly financial reporting.
Implemented computerized record management system upgrades to process personnel activities and generate reports, cutting administrative processing time by 35%.
Monitored use of diagnostic services and inpatient beds, assessing need for additional equipment and services, which led to the acquisition of two new imaging machines.

experience.title: Assistant Health Services Manager
bullets: Assisted in supervising work activities of medical, nursing, technical, and clerical personnel, conducting performance evaluations and coordinating training sessions.
Supported fiscal operations including budget planning, expenditure authorization, and coordination of financial reporting for a $4M annual budget.
Developed and maintained computerized record management systems to store and process personnel information, improving report generation speed by 30%.
Helped plan and implement programs and services, coordinating medical, nursing, and physical plant staff to ensure smooth daily operations.
Established work schedules for 40+ staff members, balancing workload and equipment availability to maintain optimal staffing levels.
Monitored use of inpatient beds and facilities, identifying resource gaps and recommending staffing adjustments to leadership.

experience.title: Administrative Coordinator
bullets: Coordinated recruitment, hiring, and training activities for clinical and administrative personnel, processing 150+ applications annually.
Maintained computerized record management systems to store and process personnel activities and information and to produce regular reports.
Assisted with fiscal operations including accounting, budget tracking, and expenditure authorization for a $2M departmental budget.
Established work schedules and assignments for 25 staff members according to workload and space availability.
Monitored use of diagnostic services and facilities, compiling data to support resource utilization assessments.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Health Services Management
